pairs.prompt_text:
In the Tutors SvelteKit app at D:\code\tutors, I need to explore the i18n implementation that exists on a remote branch. Do a "very thorough" search:

1. Run: git log --all --oneline --grep="i18n" to find i18n commits
2. Run: git branch -r to find the i18n branch name
3. Run: git show origin/i18n_lgriffin_2024:src/lib/translations/index.ts (or similar path) to see the translation config
4. Run: git show origin/i18n_lgriffin_2024:src/lib/translations/types.ts
5. Run: git show origin/i18n_lgriffin_2024:package.json | grep -A2 -B2 i18n to see the package used
6. Try to show the translation JSON files: git show origin/i18n_lgriffin_2024:src/lib/translations/en/common.json
7. Show the LanguageSwitcher component: git show origin/i18n_lgriffin_2024:src/lib/ui/components/LanguageSwitcher.svelte
8. Show the layout changes: git diff development..origin/i18n_lgriffin_2024 -- src/routes/+layout.svelte src/routes/+layout.ts src/routes/+layout.server.ts
9. Show any modified components: git diff --name-only development..origin/i18n_lgriffin_2024
10. If there's a guide.md, show it: git show origin/i18n_lgriffin_2024:src/lib/translations/guide.md

Report the full contents of each file you find, the package version, and the complete diff of changed files. I need the actual code, not summaries.
